detail.longDescription: If you're a student using Firefox, the right extensions make a real difference. uBlock Origin to cut distractions, containers to separate school vs personal browsing, Reader View for dense articles, and Weather & Clock Dashboard on your new tab so you know the weather before rushing to campus. Quick write-up on building a focused study setup: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/firefo x-for-students-the-setup-that-makes-research-and-studying-less-painful-4mhk # Firefox # Students # Productivity
